# Original Berezovsk responses for #250

`berezovsk.json.gz` contains unmodified canonical before states, player input,
Narrative, and original C/D Extraction/repair response strings for `002` and `005`.
Only unrelated transport/configuration/credential fields were excluded. No world
was regenerated and no literary text was corrected for acceptance.

Source: `life248-playability-live-evidence-20261108.tar.gz`, SHA256
`f5acde17040f4febaff01f86fba9b9e1682fb395533d949a029a99da8fa61efb`.
Original paths: `life248-playability-live/plan/{002,005}.json` and
`life248-playability-live/comparison/{002,005}/{C,D}/attempt-*.json`.
The fixture preserves response order, including the incomplete D/005 repair.
